lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Three crates of supplies for one sealed salvage lot. No opening it before purchase. That ruins the mystery.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Fuel cells. Old, ugly, and still holding charge. You did well.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Armour compound and patch resin. Not exciting, but your hull will appreciate it.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: That was not a storage battery. It was an angry storage battery.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: A healthy respect for sealed boxes is also valuable.

options.line: All right. Give me the box.
I have enough mysteries aboard already.
